title: Credit, Credit Scores and Student Finance
subject: money

sections.body: CREDIT is borrowing money to pay back later, with interest. Credit cards, loans and 'buy now, pay later' are all credit.
A CREDIT SCORE (in many countries) estimates how reliably you repay. Paying on time and not borrowing too much helps; missed payments hurt.
Student finance differs hugely by country: grants (don't repay), scholarships, and loans (with different interest and repayment rules). Read the terms carefully.
Avoid high-cost loans (like payday loans) and loan apps that ask for access to your contacts or photos. These are red flags.

quiz.q: What helps build a good credit score?
hints: Lenders want to know you'll repay.
A friend who always returns borrowed things on time is someone you'd lend to again.
quiz.explain: Paying on time shows you're reliable, which builds a good score.

quiz.q: A loan app asks for access to all your phone contacts. This is…
hints: Why would a lender need your contacts?
Some predatory apps harass borrowers' contacts.
A bank doesn't need your photos to give you an account. Why would a loan app need your contacts?
quiz.explain: It's a red flag. Predatory loan apps have used contacts to harass and shame borrowers.
